boxes.meaning: unable to move; paralysed with fear

english.meaning: unable to move; paralysed with fear
english.note: Use this when someone is stunned or stands still from fear and cannot react.

examples.english: When I saw that scene, I was completely frozen.
examples.traditional: 見到咁嘅場面，我成個呆住咗。
